Questions

Asked & answered.

Is this just a chatbot with a face?

No — it's a real-time video agent that sees, hears, and responds in under a second, with tools wired into your actual booking calendar and payment system. It doesn't just talk about appointments; it makes them and collects money for them.

What about medical questions and compliance?

The agent is fenced to your approved treatment information and never gives medical advice. Anything clinical — complications, contraindications, prescriptions — escalates to your staff with a transcript. Conversations are handled with HIPAA-conscious workflows.

How fast can we launch?

Most spas are live in about 7 days: we ingest your treatment menu and FAQ, brand the avatar, connect your calendar and PaymeGPT account, and deploy to Cloudflare's edge.

Does it replace my front desk team?

It replaces the 2 AM silence and the on-hold hangups. Your team keeps doing what humans do best — in-person care — while the AI catches every inquiry they physically can't.

Stop losing bookings to voicemail.

Talk to Ava right now. Ask her anything you'd ask a front desk — then imagine her working your website every night this year.
